body_md:
People looking for an independently owned pool and spa contractor in Tampa can compare five Certified Pool/Spa Contractor records. Each license was Current, Active on the Florida DBPR license lookup, and Sunbiz lists no parent company. The businesses are Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp, Xecutive Pools, LLC, Hickman Marcite LLC, Hive Outdoor Living LLC, and Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC.

## How we picked

Each listing was checked in the Florida DBPR license lookup for license type Certified Pool/Spa Contractor and status Current, Active. License number, licensure date, expiration, and scope come from that lookup, and each entry links to its DBPR source. Ownership was checked on Sunbiz. Where a fact comes from a company site, the entry says so. Contacts were checked on November 25, 2026.

## At a glance

- DBPR licensure dates: Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp, 04/12/2022; Xecutive Pools, LLC, 02/18/2015; Hickman Marcite LLC, 03/30/2005; Hive Outdoor Living LLC, 08/02/2013; Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC, 11/07/1997. All five expire 08/31/2028.
- Service areas: Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp, Tampa Bay area (company site: the bay area); Xecutive Pools, LLC, Hillsborough, Pasco, Pinellas, Polk, Sarasota, and Manatee counties; Hickman Marcite LLC, statewide under the certified license, with a business address in Tampa, Hillsborough County; Hive Outdoor Living LLC, Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Hernando, and Polk counties; Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC, Dade City, Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills, and the Greater Tampa Bay area.
- Company-site years: more than 10 years of experience for Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp; established 2005 for Xecutive Pools, LLC; since 1979 for Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC.

## Things to know before you go

Records for Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp, Hickman Marcite LLC, Hive Outdoor Living LLC, and Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC state the licensee can build residential swimming pools and repair residential and public swimming pools or spas, and cannot build public pools or make direct connections to water or sewer lines. Xecutive Pools, LLC's DBPR record states the licensee can repair or service public or private pools and spas, replace or install equipment, and work on interior finishes, heaters, perimeter and filter piping, and equipment housing, and cannot make direct connections to water or sewer lines.

Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp lists new pool construction, pool and spa renovations, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, and screen enclosures, lists a free consultation, and quotes 12-14 weeks for standard pool and spa projects. Xecutive Pools, LLC lists pool resurfacing, redesign, deck and patio, commercial pool renovation, tile and coping, water and fire features, outdoor kitchens and bars, additions, and pool equipment. Hive Outdoor Living LLC lists custom pools, outdoor kitchens, and backyard projects, with free estimates and financing available (company site). Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC lists custom pools, spas, travertine and paver decks, and screened enclosures.

Hive Outdoor Living LLC's address, 7606 N. Nebraska Ave, Tampa, FL 33604, is listed as the license location. Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC is at 35386 Lake Ray Drive, Dade City, FL 33525. Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp, Xecutive Pools, LLC, and Hickman Marcite LLC list Tampa addresses as well.

## FAQ

### Are these businesses independently owned?
Sunbiz lists no parent company for any of the five. Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp lists president Danays Acosta Benitez, and the company site states family-owned and operated. Xecutive Pools, LLC lists authorized members Patrick Borrelli and Tiffany Borrelli. Hickman Marcite LLC lists manager Richard L. Hickman Jr. Hive Outdoor Living LLC lists individual managers Robert F. Foster, Benjamin Kelver, and Hutton Andrew. Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC lists president Jamie J. Mills and secretary Stacy Mills; the company site names Jamie as owner.

### What do the license records say a contractor cannot do?
Every record states the licensee cannot make direct connections to water or sewer lines. Dynasty Pools and Spas, Corp, Hickman Marcite LLC, Hive Outdoor Living LLC, and Hometown Pools & Pavers, LLC also have records stating the licensee cannot build public pools.

### When were the licenses checked?
Contacts were checked on November 25, 2026. Each Florida DBPR record was Current, Active, with an expiration date of 08/31/2028.
